messages:
anna: Quick question — our public API v3->v4 rename changed `model_config` -> `model_spec` and flattened `generation.token_budget` into `limits.tokens`. A few tenants are getting 4xxs. Can we ship a lightweight field-mapper shim at the gateway to translate incoming v3 payloads to v4?
I want us to decide: automatic transparent mapping vs opt-in flag, what telemetry we attach, perf safety, and test coverage. Pinging @devon @raja for engineering takes. :eyes:

devon: +1 for a gateway mapping stopgap. Keep it declarative (mapping table) so ops can audit and edit without code changes. If we see ambiguous shapes, fail with 422 and a clear message.
Also add a header `X-Compat-Mode: v3->v4` on proxied requests so we can measure traffic and errors.

raja: I prototyped a tiny mapper in python that walks nested keys and applies simple type coercions. Example mapping table:
```python
MAPPING = {
  "model_config": "model_spec",
  "generation.token_budget": "limits.tokens",
  "generation.top_k": "sampling.top_k"
}

def apply_map(payload, mapping):
  # shallow example: walk and copy values according to dotted paths
  ...
```
It handles missing keys and preserves unknown fields.

maria: Perf note — adding a JSON walk in the gateway adds ~0.5-0.8ms p95 on small requests in our staging tests. For high-QPS routes that matters. We should gate the mapper behind either an opt-in header or tenant-level flag, or only enable it for the first 30d automatically for new/low-QPS tenants.

anna: I get that. My worry: customers won't set headers, so opt-in may leave many broken. Proposal: automatic mapping for all tenants for 30 days (transparent), emit response header `X-Compat-Detected: v3` and a telemetry event `compat.detected` with tenant id. After 30 days, switch to requiring header/opt-in and start returning deprecation warnings in responses and docs.

devon: For safety add these controls:
- schema validation after mapping (reject if invalid)
- a circuit-breaker metric (compat.mapping.error_rate). If error_rate > threshold, disable mapping globally for that route and alert.
- ensure mapping is idempotent (apply->validate->no double-mapping on repeated requests).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: mapping-gateway v0.1 deployed to staging. Link: https://ci/release/1234 (logs attached)

raja: Tests: will add unit tests for each mapping rule, integration tests using a corpus of real v3 payloads (sanitized), and a round-trip test (v3 -> map -> validate) to ensure nothing lost. Also add a small fuzzer for dotted paths.

maria: I'll run perf baselines against staging with mapping enabled and produce a threshold recommendation. If p95 delta > 1ms on critical routes, we'll flip to opt-in only and add a user-visible deprecation banner in the Console instead.

anna: Action items summary:
- devon: implement declarative mapping table + header + circuit-breaker + schema validation (owner)
- raja: tests + sanitized corpus + fuzzer (owner)
- maria: perf baseline and gating thresholds (owner)
- anna: rollout comms, deprecation messaging, and 30-day automatic window coordination (owner)
ETA: staging by EOW, canary next week if staging looks clean. 

anna: Any objections? Otherwise I'll create the RFC follow-up doc with rollout timeline and add owners.

devon: No objections from me. I'll post a short PR with mapping table format for review. :+1:

raja: sounds good. I'll drop the sample corpus in the tests repo.

maria: ok from perf side, will post numbers here when done.

anna: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
